scope: Acceptance-priority ordinary finger-launched top; no claim, task build, GPU run, purchase or submission.
decisive_reason: No evidence that ordinary spinning improves on the final importance objection in PR2862. A physical novelty distinction from2722 and the accepted Jenga precedent do not establish this task importance.

product.name: ForeverSpin Stainless Steel brushed
product.availability: Product Shopify event available:true; no purchase attempted.
product.ordinary_launch_observation: Official how-to video inspected as contact sheet: hold stem with thumb and index finger, tip on surface, snap fingers then release.
unknowns: Center of mass and moments of inertia

physics.qualification: Fixed-tip upright stability, not exact retail-top minimum successful spin. Illustrative disk with radius14mm and center height6/8/10mm; actual inertia unmeasured. This is a sensitivity illustration, not a physical lower/upper bound.

robot.limitations: Motor limits are installed model parameters, not a demonstration of achievable contact motion. A stem locked to one axial wrist alone cannot reach the illustrative46–78rad/s. Multiple-joint body angular velocity is not bounded by one joint alone. Parallel jaws have no independent tangential finger stroke.
robot.possible_native_contact_route: Opposite pads of two arms move tangentially in opposite directions, rolling stem while tip stays on surface, then both release. At assumed3mm stem radius, equal/opposite pad speed0.137–0.234m/s reaches illustrative threshold. Total angular impulse needs total tangential impulse0.042–0.071Ns (~0.42–0.71N over100ms). Not proof of collision-free reach or sufficiently balanced release.
not_permitted: Changing collision friction by controller phase
Rescaling retail toy to help reach

comparators.distinction: Fixed-axis Twister arrow flick; top has six-DOF release and gyroscopic balance. Pending is not accepted.
Complete familiar Jenga game turn with physical load-sensitive block selection; not blanket approval of balancing puzzles.
Two-card house rejected for importance; balancing puzzle without demonstrated real-world impact. Closest negative precedent for top as presently framed.

reopen_only_if: Substantive ordinary-use outcome or importance evidence beyond spin duration/desk entertainment/physics demonstration
Measured or manufacturer-grade full retail geometry and mass distribution
Independent acceptance of broader top-play task, rather than inference from pending2722
